maildo handles your mail from the terminal. People get readable tables, and scripts and coding agents get stable JSON. A change to many messages shows a preview first, and limits you set for each account decide what a script or agent may do.

Usage:
  maildo [command]

Examples:
maildo login
maildo list
maildo search "from:anna invoice newer:30d"
maildo read 4d1a2f3
maildo archive --query "from:deals@shop.example" --all

Accounts and setup
  auth               Manage your accounts and their logins
  config             Read and change maildo settings
  doctor             Check an account's servers, login and folders
  login              Log in to a mail account

Folders
  folders            List and change folders

Search and read
  list               List the newest messages in a folder
  read               Read a message
  search             Search your mail
  thread             Show the messages of a conversation, with the start of each

Write and send
  draft              Write, change and send drafts
  forward            Forward a message (saves a draft unless you add --send)
  reply              Reply to a message (saves a draft unless you add --send)
  send               Send a new message

Attachments
  attachments        Work with the attachments of messages and drafts

Change messages
  archive            Archive messages
  categories         Show or replace message categories (on Gmail, your own labels)
  copy               Copy messages to another folder (on Gmail, this adds a label)
  delete             Move messages to Trash
  flag               Flag messages or remove the flag
  junk               Move messages to the Junk folder
  mark               Mark messages as read or unread
  move               Move messages to another folder
  restore            Move messages back from Trash or Junk (to the inbox, or to --to)

Rules
  rules              List and change Inbox rules (Outlook)

Outlook
  outlook            Commands that only work with Outlook accounts

Additional Commands:
  completion         Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help               Help about any command
  update             Check for and install the latest version

Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
  -h, --help              help for maildo
      --include-meta      Wrap machine output as {data, meta} (commands that expose request metadata)
      --jq string         Transform stable JSON output with a jq expression (commands with machine output)
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --plain             Print unstyled, copy-safe text (commands with human output)
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Render stable JSON output through a Go text/template (commands with machine output)
  -v, --version           version for maildo

Use "maildo [command] --help" for more information about a command.
